## 9199b47fab1e

**Reproduced lesson shortcut; target left unchanged.** For generator SHA
`ab3973b42e5d3d849239ba33477d2be40d2a7dcd355a0b8b3b6024e1e6c77a7a`,
seed 1, difficulty `easy`, and sample indices 0–3, all four generated inputs pass
the target validator and belong to the documented generator domain.

The rival `nearest_seed_manhattan_distance_ignoring_walls` matches all three
demonstrations and differs on the query. The demonstration wall-cell counts are
5, 0, and 3, but those walls do not force an output difference from unobstructed
Manhattan propagation; the query has 5 wall cells and finally distinguishes the
true wall-aware behavior.

Evidence and exact supported apply record:
`checks/audit/9199b47fab1e/finding.json`,
`checks/audit/9199b47fab1e/input.json`,
`checks/audit/9199b47fab1e/racket.json`, and
`checks/audit/9199b47fab1e/rival.json`.

This is a concrete teaching ambiguity, not a rule-authority defect. A useful
repair would ensure at least one demonstration has a wall configuration where
wall-aware and wall-ignoring propagation visibly disagree.
